instruction: Look up the most recent open issue in "kubernetes/kubernetes" that has the label "kind/bug", then write it in the format "#<number> | <labels> | <title>" to "$HOME/Desktop/gh_open_issues_2_2.txt". If there is no matching issue, save an empty file.
reference_command: gh issue list --repo kubernetes/kubernetes --state open --search 'label:"kind/bug" sort:created-desc' --limit 1 --json number,title,labels --jq '.[] | "#\(.number) | \(([.labels[].name] | if length == 0 then "none" else join(",") end)) | \(.title)"' > "$HOME/Desktop/gh_open_issues_2_2.txt"
